index.remember_clear_choice: Remember this selection and clear it next time
index.download_no_tip: This type of download is not supported yet. Please copy the link and use other tools to download.
index.import_placeholder: When adding multiple items, ensure each line contains only one (each link on a new line)
index.win_install_tip: For the first time using this software, please right-click and select 'Run as administrator'
index.download_queued: has been added to the queue, current queue length：{count}
index.start_err_content: The current startup process has encountered an issue. Do you want to reset the application?
index.reset_app_tip: This operation will delete intercepted data and data related to this application. Please proceed with caution!
index.comments_no_support: Comments are only supported for WeChat Channels resources
index.comments_entry_guide: Start capture and open the target in WeChat Channels. Once it appears in the list, choose Get Comments; select one first when several resources are listed.
index.comments_select_one: Select one WeChat Channels resource (only one can be processed at a time)
index.comments_status_queued: Queued, waiting for the Channels page…
index.comments_status_running: Verifying the target and fetching comments…
index.comments_already_running: A comment task is already running for this resource
index.comments_partial_tip: Some entries could not be fully parsed. Recognized content is shown; retry or inspect the redacted diagnostics for format changes.
index.comments_no_comments_tip: This is a valid empty result, not a timeout. You can fetch again later.
index.comments_local_only: Comment history stays on this device and is removed with the resource.
index.comments_consent_content: Comments may include other people's display names, IP regions, and content, and will be stored with this resource on your device. Confirm that you are authorized to collect and use this data and will follow platform rules and applicable law.
index.comments_error_identity_unavailable: The complete identity for this video is not ready. Show the target in the Channels feed, play or refresh it, then retry.
index.comments_error_timeout: Timed out. Keep the Channels page open, fully quit WeChat, and reopen it so the latest script loads.
index.comments_error_target_mismatch: Target verification failed. Potentially mismatched comments were blocked; refresh the target video and retry.
index.comments_error_request_failed: The comment request failed. Expand a comment section once in Channels, then retry.
index.comments_error_login_expired: Your WeChat session may have expired. Sign in again and retry.
index.comments_error_parse_failed: A response arrived, but its comment format was not recognized. Retry or inspect the redacted diagnostics.
index.comments_error_interrupted: The previous comment task was interrupted when the app closed. Fetch again.

setting.restart_tip: Keep default if unsure, please restart software after modification
setting.filename_rules_tip: Input controls filename length (excluding timestamp, 0 means invalid, effective when description exists), switch controls whether to add timestamp at filename end
setting.full_intercept_tip: Whether to fully intercept WeChat video accounts, No: only intercept video details
setting.insert_tail_tip: Intercept whether new data is added to the end of the list
setting.upstream_proxy_tip: For combining with other proxy tools, format: http://username:password@your.proxy.server:port
setting.download_proxy_tip: Whether to use upstream proxy for downloads
setting.connections_tip: Keep default if unsure, usually CPU cores * 2, for faster downloads
setting.use_headers_tip: Default system filtering, Define headers for downloads, comma separated
setting.mime_map_tip: JSON format, keep default if unsure, please restart software after modification
setting.domain_rule_tip:

*.qq.com
video.qq.com
example.com

# Exclude
!static.qq.com
